answer: Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The sonnet counter is kept in tide and vertex shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1433 identities would post 4569 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
